name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession for go-karting, fueled by watching local races near his hometown. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before landing a role at a small racing team. There, he honed his skills in data analysis and vehicle setup, quickly gaining a reputation for his sharp intuition and ability to translate data into tangible performance gains. Nikola believes that a collaborative approach, combined with a deep understanding of the driver's feedback, is key to unlocking the full potential of a racing machine.

He's now looking to take the next step in his career by joining the Kart Academy, where he hopes to help the team achieve new levels of success. His meticulous nature and natural talent for teaching make him an asset to any team, and he is eager to share his passion for motorsport with the next generation of drivers. Nikola is also known for his unconventional methods, unafraid to challenge established norms in the pursuit of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a lean build and focused gaze.

Has a habit of pacing around the garage while deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
